content.caseIdentity: T. Arivandandam v. T.V. Satyapal, (1977) 4 SCC 467
content.holding: Courts should reject a plaint that is manifestly vexatious and meritless under Order VII Rule 11.
content.relevance: Power and duty to reject bogus plaints at the threshold.

evidence.note: 2-Judge Bench judgment in Civil Appeal No. 1403 of 1977; 1977 INSC 195; (1977) 4 SCC 467; 1978 (1) SCR 742.
